andrewcraddock1980: Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

A supply man offered Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into P-F22. Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo has learned to walk bent double.
The men have learned that Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo collects shell fuses. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.
Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a march played slightly too slowly, but something knocks once every revolution.
Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at P-F22 and fired once. Florian Damiendeberr was badly wounded.

Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. Back from the raid, Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Sunday' (common). Nobody asked where it came from. Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo was on the dawn watch at P-F22 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Wendel Ztardvst of the Hegemony (@_ztardvst).
big_hoodie_kid: Clement "Spark" Kid unpacked a rosary of rough beads at S-S9. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Clement "Spark" Kid kept watch so that Emil Majormalprac could sleep. Then Emil kept watch so that Spark could. Neither slept.
Clement "Spark" Kid remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Clement "Spark" Kid spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
Clement "Spark" Kid won his boots at cards from a lance corporal in S-S9. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Clement "Spark" Kid kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A bullet clipped Clement "Spark" Kid's helmet at S-S9 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony (@heheheha1939). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Clement "Spark" Kid is number 384. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Clement "Spark" Kid helped stack spare sandbags at S-S9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Back on the fire step at S-S9. Clement "Spark" Kid says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Rematch. Clement "Spark" Kid lost everything he won, plus a rosary of rough beads. The whole dugout watched.
Clement "Spark" Kid of the Concord and Walter Juizy of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Saint-Ash crossroads now wait for it before they sleep.

A bullet hit Clement "Spark" Kid in the neck at S-S9. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Quentin "Crow" Alpharius of the Hegemony (@i_am_alpharius123). Clement "Spark" Kid was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door. Clement "Spark" Kid slipped away in the night. The orderly who sat with him says he was not afraid.
Gustav Kid took the same post at S-S9 where Clement "Spark" Kid stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Walter Byzantineemp and Gustav Kid split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
cbeattie.1770: Casimir Cbeattie introduced himself as a railway porter from Ashford Vale. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Casimir Cbeattie studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked S-F19 in the dark to learn it by heart. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

A shell burst over S-F19 and threw Casimir Cbeattie into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier. Victory at Hill 304. Casimir Cbeattie let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Casimir Cbeattie wore a fresh bandage at S-F19 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Casimir Cbeattie is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Cbeattie and Florian "Button" Thebaileebla carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Cbeattie heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Casimir Cbeattie was hit hard in the fight at S-F19 before anyone could fire. The raider was Silas Michigangame of the Concord. Raider: Silas Michigangame of the Concord (@michigangamer). On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Casimir Cbeattie wrote the name in his diary with unusual care. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Cbeattie rejoined the squad at S-F19. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. The clerk counted the names twice. Casimir Cbeattie is number 269 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Casimir Cbeattie helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Casimir Cbeattie reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F19 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Bastian "Ghost" Kgss of the Concord (@kg1912ss).

Three days with a bandage, and Casimir Cbeattie is back at S-F19. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.
Casimir Cbeattie saw Konrad "Crow" Dinhdong freeze up on the fire step at the Brickworks. Casimir said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

A bullet hit Casimir Cbeattie in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F19. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Severin Moovin of the Concord (@da_moovin). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Casimir Cbeattie fell at S-F19 and never moved again. Shot by Severin Moovin of the Concord (@da_moovin).
Valentin Cbeattie asked about Casimir Cbeattie on arriving at S-F19. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

At S-F19 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Valentin Cbeattie won the bet. Gustav Burgosgeovan was grazed. Valentin Cbeattie was hit twice at S-F19, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Oskar Gece of the Concord (@gece.ds). The bearers reached Valentin Cbeattie at S-F19 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Oskar Gece of the Concord (@gece.ds).
Severin Cbeattie had heard about Valentin Cbeattie's courage. At S-F19, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
d00d1eb0b: Anselm Ddebb arrived on Day 11 as a replacement. The men in P-F4 had been fighting for 11 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Anselm Ddebb could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Yann Next wrote a letter for Anselm Ddebb's mother, because Anselm could not find the words. Anselm signed it.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Anselm Ddebb waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.

Anselm Ddebb was hit through the stomach at P-F4. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Clement Alexquinn of the Concord (@alexquinn2802). Anselm Ddebb looked over the parapet at P-F4 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Clement Alexquinn of the Concord (@alexquinn2802).
The papers say Edmund "Crow" Ddebb. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Anselm Ddebb's eyes. Nobody in P-F4 argues.
Edmund "Crow" Ddebb laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.

At P-F4 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Edmund "Crow" Ddebb turned around and took a shovel blow. Cyril Mace of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Cyril Mace of the Concord (@monty.mace).
dominickthebombinick25: The old hands of S-C6 have been here since Day 1. Gideon Dominicktheb has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

A bullet clipped Gideon Dominicktheb's helmet at S-C6 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Florian Team of the Hegemony (@phs_jrotc_drill_team). Gideon Dominicktheb fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit was badly wounded. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Gideon Dominicktheb watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Gideon Dominicktheb returned to S-C6 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Gideon Dominicktheb is number 672. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Gideon Dominicktheb wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Gideon Dominicktheb rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
Brass cases piled up around Gideon Dominicktheb's boots at S-C6. Out of all those rounds, one found Lucien Somehowballi, grazed.
Gideon Dominicktheb has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.

Across from S-C6, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Gideon Dominicktheb saw it. Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit was badly wounded. A shell burst directly over S-C6. Gideon Dominicktheb was found under the duckboards, alive, but only just. Gideon Dominicktheb died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
A letter came with Anselm Dominicktheb: "I am Gideon Dominicktheb's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Anselm Dominicktheb had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Pavel Zdsh crossed it, Anselm Dominicktheb fired. Pavel Zdsh was badly wounded.
emperornoblez: Zeno Emperornoble came from Halden, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Zeno Emperornoble lent Otto "Parson" Vicious a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Zeno Emperornoble offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Zeno Emperornoble fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too.

Zeno Emperornoble swept the enemy parapet at S-S5 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Dorian "Ash" Juanito was grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Zeno Emperornoble watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Zeno Emperornoble put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Zeno Emperornoble is number 464. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Zeno Emperornoble helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Zeno Emperornoble fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Dorian Maxhuntertat, now grazed.
Zeno Emperornoble began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
Zeno Emperornoble had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Konrad "Mole" Egilhermanss was grazed.
Zeno Emperornoble fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Jonas "Brick" Ware was badly wounded.
The reply to Zeno Emperornoble's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
huntertheyankee: Pavel Huntertheyan told the sergeant he was a medical student. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Pavel Huntertheyan wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl and Pavel Huntertheyan both swear they saw a ghost at the Hanging Bridge. Each says the other screamed first. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Pavel Huntertheyan looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Pavel Huntertheyan added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
Pavel Huntertheyan offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
Pavel Huntertheyan polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
Pavel Huntertheyan dreamt he was back in Brennmoor, working as a medical student. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
The whole squad at Q-F19 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Pavel Huntertheyan's bullet that found Albin Deer, grazed.
j.t.772: Bastian Jt came from Greyhallow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

Bastian Jt of the Hegemony spotted Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar of the Concord repairing a parapet at Hill 304. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Bastian Jt could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Bastian Jt's bunk. He has named it Duchess.
Duchess the rat now waits for Bastian Jt at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Duchess ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Bastian Jt followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Duchess his life.
Bastian Jt has not seen Duchess for two days. He tells everyone rats come and go. He still leaves crumbs on the box.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Bastian Jt helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Bastian Jt reached up to fix a sandbag at S-S8 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich of the Concord (@coreyjmcmichael). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bastian Jt answered to number 370. Grey Mill has been won. Bastian Jt listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Bastian Jt's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-S8 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz of the Concord lost a cap on a night patrol near the Chalk Pits. Bastian Jt of the Hegemony found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.
Bastian Jt hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.

Bastian Jt took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-S8, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich of the Concord (@coreyjmcmichael).
Bastian Jt spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
jdavidfrancisco: The quartermaster asked Pavel Jdavidfranci to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included. Pavel Jdavidfranci transferred to the signallers. The men in R-C4 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-C4 with the rations. Pavel Jdavidfranci ate while listening to the revised orders. A letter from home found Pavel Jdavidfranci before the night shift. Pavel Jdavidfranci folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet found Pavel Jdavidfranci at R-C4, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Rafael "Owl" Dooley of the Hegemony (@kaelan_dooley). A letter from home found Pavel Jdavidfranci before the night shift. Pavel Jdavidfranci folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Pavel Jdavidfranci answered to number 770. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Pavel Jdavidfranci stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Pavel Jdavidfranci died waiting. The men at R-C4 have not stopped talking about it.
The papers connected Henrik Jdavidfranci to Pavel Jdavidfranci. The men took longer to learn Henrik Jdavidfranci's own habits, but they made the effort.

Henrik Jdavidfranci sent a pigeon back to headquarters. The pigeon came back two hours later. Henrik Jdavidfranci took it personally. A letter from home found Henrik Jdavidfranci before the night shift. Henrik Jdavidfranci folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Henrik Jdavidfranci tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-C4 is up. A letter from home found Henrik Jdavidfranci before the night shift. Henrik Jdavidfranci folded it small and kept it close.

Henrik Jdavidfranci wrote to a girl from the dance hall, maybe. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars. A letter from home found Henrik Jdavidfranci before the night shift. Henrik Jdavidfranci folded it small and kept it close.

Night raid. Henrik Jdavidfranci crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Henrik Jdavidfranci. The corporal called out the mail. Henrik Jdavidfranci heard the name and almost ran.
najeb_johnson: Nobody asked Benedikt Johnson why he came. Nobody in Q-F12 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Benedikt Johnson was hit hard in the fight at Q-F12 before anyone could fire. The raider was Walter "Crow" Viti of the Hegemony. Raider: Walter "Crow" Viti of the Hegemony (@viti_w02). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Benedikt Johnson stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Benedikt Johnson's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at Q-F12 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F12 with the rations. Benedikt Johnson ate while listening to the revised orders.
Benedikt Johnson checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
Benedikt Johnson watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
Benedikt Johnson tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
A bullet clipped Benedikt Johnson's helmet at Q-F12 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Anselm "Doc" Juliofck of the Hegemony (@juliofck).
The wound on Benedikt Johnson's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
ollybats: Yann "Smokes" Ollybats, a butcher's boy from Ashford Vale, was sent forward on Day 13 to fill a gap in V-F9. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Yann "Smokes" Ollybats swept the enemy parapet at V-F9 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Roland Franciszekha was grazed. A bullet went into Yann "Smokes" Ollybats's chest just under the heart at V-F9. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Isidor Nult of the Concord (@nult.de). Yann "Smokes" Ollybats was killed on watch at V-F9. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Isidor Nult of the Concord (@nult.de).
A letter came with Dorian Ollybats: "I am Yann "Smokes" Ollybats's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

A bullet hit Dorian Ollybats in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at V-F9. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Matthias Tpackterrori of the Concord (@tpackterrorist).
Dorian Ollybats lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
pablo404585: Bastian "Saint" Pablo came up on Day 9 carrying news from Lindenbruck. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Bastian "Saint" Pablo was hit in the foot through his boot at S-R12. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Hume of the Hegemony (@hunnnter_hume). Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Bastian "Saint" Pablo wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The bearers moved Bastian "Saint" Pablo's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Bastian "Saint" Pablo is number 856. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-R12. Bastian "Saint" Pablo has learned to walk bent double.
Bastian "Saint" Pablo held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Marek "Lucky" Pablo arrived carrying the family name of Bastian "Saint" Pablo. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Marek "Lucky" Pablo kept Jakub Ronne awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Lucky could have walked there blind.

A bullet found Marek "Lucky" Pablo at S-R12, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Wendel "Hollow" Arthur of the Hegemony (@arthur.ds999). A single shot at S-R12. Marek "Lucky" Pablo sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Wendel "Hollow" Arthur of the Hegemony (@arthur.ds999).
Another member of the House of Pablo reached the line: Benedikt Pablo. He asked where Marek "Lucky" Pablo had slept, then chose a different corner.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Benedikt Pablo aimed a step ahead and fired: Felix Varsikasikra, badly wounded.
A round went through the rim of Benedikt Pablo's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Quentin Nieuwenhuis of the Hegemony (@gideon_j_a_nieuwenhuis_).
photogeneic_varg: Konrad Varg arrived on Day 13 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Konrad Varg reads Edmund Epgmaker's letters from home out loud, because Edmund never learned to read. Konrad leaves out the sad parts. Edmund knows.
The trench wall shook against Konrad Varg's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
Konrad Varg spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
raptor2561: Gustav "Mud" Raptor came up on Day 3 carrying news from Halden. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Orders assigned Gustav "Mud" Raptor to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.
Gustav "Mud" Raptor caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
Dawn watch. Gustav "Mud" Raptor put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Dietrich Linningorchi, grazed.

A flare caught Gustav "Mud" Raptor halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached. A letter from home reached Gustav "Mud" Raptor before dusk. Gustav "Mud" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Gustav "Mud" Raptor looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Gustav "Mud" Raptor had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver crossed it, Gustav "Mud" Raptor fired. Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver was grazed.

Gustav "Mud" Raptor was hit through the chest at R-F5. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Benedikt Shi of the Hegemony (@rei0_shi4). Gustav "Mud" Raptor was killed outright at R-F5, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Benedikt Shi of the Hegemony (@rei0_shi4).

Isidor "Mole" Raptor arrived carrying the family name of Gustav "Mud" Raptor. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. The transfer made Isidor "Mole" Raptor a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Isidor "Mole" Raptor's ear at R-F5 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Konrad Danielmcmena of the Hegemony (@danielmcmenamy). A letter from home reached Isidor "Mole" Raptor before dusk. Isidor "Mole" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier.

Isidor "Mole" Raptor was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F5. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Gustav Marksebastio of the Hegemony (@marksebastion).

Isidor "Mole" Raptor survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at R-F5, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Isidor "Mole" Raptor helped stack spare sandbags at R-F5. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home reached Isidor "Mole" Raptor before dusk. Isidor "Mole" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier.

Isidor "Mole" Raptor tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. A letter from home reached Isidor "Mole" Raptor before dusk. Isidor "Mole" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier. The clerk counted the names twice. Isidor "Mole" Raptor is number 201 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Isidor "Mole" Raptor kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Isidor "Mole" Raptor fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Bastian "Owl" Branden was grazed trying to cross it. Isidor "Mole" Raptor reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F5 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Dorian Hensley of the Hegemony (@christian.__.hensley). A letter from home reached Isidor "Mole" Raptor before dusk. Isidor "Mole" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet hit Isidor "Mole" Raptor in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F5. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Otto Baumann of the Hegemony (@tegan_baumann). A letter from home reached Isidor "Mole" Raptor before dusk. Isidor "Mole" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier.
For days Isidor "Mole" Raptor was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.

Isidor "Mole" Raptor had just lit a cigarette at R-F5 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck). A letter from home reached Isidor "Mole" Raptor before dusk. Isidor "Mole" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round came through the loophole Isidor "Mole" Raptor was watching at R-F5 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Benedikt Snake of the Hegemony (@jake_the_snake6424). Isidor "Mole" Raptor was hit at R-F5 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Benedikt Snake of the Hegemony (@jake_the_snake6424).
Zeno Raptor took the same post at R-F5 where Isidor "Mole" Raptor stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
tomishidk: Quentin Tomishidk came up with a draft of replacements on Day 3. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

A pump handle snapped off in Quentin Tomishidk's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles. The transfer made Quentin Tomishidk a stretcher bearer. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Dorian Coletonmarti's name scratched on it. Quentin Tomishidk kicked it back. It did not come again.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Quentin Tomishidk tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F18 is up. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F18 with the rations. Quentin Tomishidk ate while listening to the revised orders.

Quentin Tomishidk remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Tomishidk. Quentin Tomishidk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Quentin Tomishidk sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Tomishidk. Quentin Tomishidk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Quentin Tomishidk splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.

Quentin Tomishidk draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters. Today, under fire at the Brickworks, that habit was the only steady thing in S-F18. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Tomishidk. Quentin Tomishidk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Quentin Tomishidk threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Nils Hellcat was down and screaming for a medic. (@hellcat34106) The Hegemony sentry, Cyril Miller, shouted once. Quentin Tomishidk silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@ryder_miller11) The Hegemony raiders came over at S-F18 in the middle of the night. Quentin Tomishidk met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Walter Juizy of the Hegemony (@juizy_44).

Leopold Tomishidk had heard about Quentin Tomishidk's courage. At S-F18, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Now serving as a stretcher bearer, Leopold Tomishidk discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Leopold Tomishidk worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Tomishidk. Leopold Tomishidk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Leopold Tomishidk got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 215. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Leopold Tomishidk stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Norbert Bwk and Leopold Tomishidk cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Leopold Tomishidk held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.
A patient at the aid post asked Leopold Tomishidk for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen.
The patient has added a stove and three chairs to the kitchen drawing. Leopold Tomishidk asks about each detail while changing the dressing.
Before evacuation, the patient asked Leopold Tomishidk to tear the drawing from the paper lining the wall. He managed it without losing the stove.
vincent.correaa: Dietrich "Brick" Correaa reported to T-F8 with his mother's thimble sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Wendel "Shadow" Warren cut Dietrich "Brick" Correaa's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Dietrich "Brick" Correaa did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Dietrich "Brick" Correaa's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Dietrich "Brick" Correaa said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Dietrich "Brick" Correaa went out with the wiring party at T-F8. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.

A bullet went through Dietrich "Brick" Correaa's upper arm at T-F8 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Oskar "Rabbit" Type of the Concord (@mg42svt40m1919type99k98k). Dietrich "Brick" Correaa was killed outright at T-F8, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Oskar "Rabbit" Type of the Concord (@mg42svt40m1919type99k98k).
A letter came with Leopold Correaa: "I am Dietrich "Brick" Correaa's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Leopold Correaa drew the counter-mine plans by candlelight. Below the Bone Quarry the earth is now a maze, and he knows every turn.
